    • padString

      public static String padString(Component c, String inp, String tstr)
      Convenience routine for padding a string using the default font.

      Pads inp with trailing spaces so that, when rendered in c's font, its pixel width approximates tstr's pixel width as closely as possible (adding one space at a time until the width gap stops shrinking).

      Parameters:
      c - the component supplying the font metrics used to measure pixel widths
      inp - the string to be padded; null is treated as empty
      tstr - the target string-- try to return a string that renders at about the same pixel width
      Returns:
      inp (or the empty string) with zero or more trailing spaces appended
